title: Remote Host rate-limit fallback

acceptanceCriteria.statement: Remote active account cards must prefer verified remote rate-limit values when those remote windows contain meaningful data.
Remote active account cards must fall back to meaningful saved-account windows only when remote rate-limit data is missing, zeroed, partial, expired, or suspicious.
Saved fallback rate-limit windows must be borrowed from the canonical saved account identity, not from email alone.

targetSurface: CodexPill remote rate-limit resolution, account catalog projection, and runtime validation snapshot

nonClaims: Does not exercise live SSH, live Codex app-server behavior, real remote auth mutation, or a real remote filesystem.
Does not prove native click automation or live menu-bar interaction.
Does not prove final native menu pixels for fallback labels.
Does not prove live macOS menu-bar behavior.
